Standard: The CSA system captures, stores, tracks, and maintains all product configuration information. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) The CSA records and reports accurately reflect the current physical configuration of the air system.
(2) The CSA tool used for capturing, storing, tracking, and maintaining production configuration information preclude unauthorized changes and include documentation defining the environment and intended use of the tool to ensure alignment with the overall needs of the air system and program.
